description.content:
OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE via auth-handler, which federates to Clerk.

auth-handler is the OIDC issuer — it redirects to Clerk for login, then issues a platform JWT.
The token returned here is a platform token accepted by the API authorizer.

To get a token:
1. Open this folder's Authorization tab
2. Click 'Get New Access Token'
3. Sign in via the Clerk login page (opened by auth-handler)
4. Click 'Use Token'

All requests in this folder inherit that token.
Works on both Local and Dev (AWS) environments.

Clears the auth-handler browser session cookie and the saved platformToken.

After running this:
1. In the Platform Login Flow folder → Authorization tab → delete the cached 'Platform Token'
2. Click 'Get New Access Token' to start a fresh Clerk login

This forces a clean re-authentication so org_id is picked up fresh.

exec: console.log('Session cleared. Now go to Platform Login Flow → Authorization → delete cached token → Get New Access Token.');

oauth2.value: openid profile email offline_access agents:read agents:write
